recentItems.title: Celebrate The Holidays (Video) - Daniel Powter
recentItems.description:
The official visualizer for Daniel Powter 's first-ever original holiday song, “Celebrate The Holidays”

An uplifting, uptempo track filled with a festive spirit, the song captures the joy of Christmas traditions—dancing in the snow, trimming the tree, and gathering with loved ones. 


Lyrics:
Everyone knows that Christmas comes each year
It's the season of love and of laughter, joy and cheer
When the winter casts her spell, and we hear them old sleigh bells, 
and the holidays start ringing in our ears

Everyone knows a little peace and love will do
And the children are singing them Christmas carols too
When we're dancing in the snow, or underneath the mistletoe, 
then the magic lifts us high into the mood

I'm gonna celebrate this holiday, 
everybody knows Santa's on his way
I'm gonna celebrate this holiday with you, woo
And we laugh, we laugh with glee, as we trim the Christmas tree
Well, I'm gonna celebrate this holiday with you

Well, hurry up, hurry up, don't be late, let the music set you free
Well, we're gonna have a good time you and me
We're doing it all again on New Year's Eve

When we're dancing in the snow, or underneath the mistletoe, 
then the magic lifts us high into the mood

I'm gonna celebrate this holiday, everybody knows Santa's on his way
I'm gonna celebrate this holiday with you, woo
And we laugh, we laugh with glee, as we trim the Christmas tree
Well, I'm gonna celebrate this holiday, 'cause if you're not with me, it won't be the same
I'm gonna celebrate the holidays with you

recentItems.title: City of Angels - Daniel Powter
recentItems.description:
Daniel Powter returns with City of Angels, his first original release since 2021. The track is a soaring, piano-driven tribute to the two cities that shaped him most — Los Angeles and Paris — offering a hopeful reflection on belonging, beauty, and the pursuit of possibility.

“I’ve carried these cities in my bones for years. This song is about what they’ve taught me about resilience, and about finding light — wherever you are.” – Daniel Powter
